cited = the claim's evidence ids found in the index
invalid = ids not in the index

span.p:
a number in the text that is not in the cited evidence?
(number_supported, rounding by the decimals written)

names residents, experts or the RIVM rules

severity style: shown to the reviewer, never changes the status

span.p:
claim.verification = status, flags, numbers in text and unsupported,
cited_valid, cited_invalid

div.style: color: rgb(29, 39, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center; width: 460px;

span.p:
section checks: coverage_gaps = salient evidence not cited ·
repeated_openers · metrics (grounded / weak / unsupported rate,
citation validity, number support, coverage_salient, claim types, perspectives)

span.p: draft.section_checks · shown in tab 3, counted in every run

div.style: color: rgb(29, 39, 51) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 460px; text-align: center; width: 460px;

span.p:
The verifier flags, it never rewrites a claim (design decision: flag, never rewrite).
The same verify_claim runs again on every edit during review (recheck).
